changeSet.sql: if not exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'AssetDataProfileSample') begin create table [dbo].[AssetDataProfileSample]( [ID] bigint identity not null, [AssetDataProfileID] bigint not null, [SampleType] nvarchar(100) not null, [Key] nvarchar(200) null, [Value] nvarchar(200) not null, constraint [PK_AssetDataProfileSample] primary key clustered ([ID], AssetDataProfileID) ) end

changeSet.sql: if exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_AssetDataProfileSample_AssetDataProfileID') begin drop index [IX_AssetDataProfileSample_AssetDataProfileID] on [dbo].[AssetDataProfileSample] end GO if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_AssetDataProfileSample_AssetDataProfileID') begin create nonclustered index [IX_AssetDataProfileSample_AssetDataProfileID] on [dbo].[AssetDataProfileSample] ([AssetDataProfileID]) include ([Key], [SampleType], [Value]) with (ONLINE = ON) end
